verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's official CLI has a documented `bw serve` mode that exposes the vault as a local RESTful Vault Management API, with its own OpenAPI document, which an agent can query for TOTP codes and items. A first-party MCP server, verified with a stdio handshake, also gives AI assistants direct vault access without screen-scraping. Missing for 10: a hands-on probe actually querying the `bw serve` endpoint for a TOTP code or secret, and in-depth first-party documentation in the pack detailing the endpoint's routes and authentication.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app

citations.quote: the CLI whose documented `bw serve` mode exposes the whole vault as a local RESTful API (Vault Management API) an agent can query for TOTP codes and items.
The Vault Management API page embeds its own OpenAPI document for the CLI's `bw serve` local server.
The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI assistants with secure access to Bitwarden password manager functionality
